name: Thoracolumbar Spine Fracture
definition: Traumatic fracture of the thoracic or lumbar spine, including compression, burst, flexion-distraction and fracture-dislocation patterns.

typical: Severe focal back pain after trauma

investigations.principle: CT defines bony morphology; MRI assesses neural elements and posterior ligament complex.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when the condition-specific question requires soft-tissue, neural, marrow or occult-injury assessment.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs/CT according to the condition-specific imaging pathway.

amber: Bracing versus surgery depends on morphology, neurology and stability.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Bhagna principles may complement recovery only after modern stability assessment.

patientEducation.summary: Traumatic fracture of the thoracic or lumbar spine, including compression, burst, flexion-distraction and fracture-dislocation patterns.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for major trauma, acute/progressive neurological deficit, severe infection/systemic illness, vascular compromise or other listed red flags.
